newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates ease in good liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates ease in good liquidity.

text.p: Hungarian overnight interbank interest rates finished lower on Monday as the banks had already replenished their reserves before the December 20 tax payment date, dealers said.
"There is sufficient liquidity, the banks were well prepared for the tax payment," said Postabank's Karoly Barath.
Overnight rates opened at 23 percent and closed at 21.75/22.00, compared with Saturday's close around 23 percent.
